content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to obtain data using Modbus RTU from the ports on [company_name] [product_name]? In our project, all pumps are managed and monitored by [company_name] [product_name], which we want to connect to the building management system (BMS). Can [product_name] communicate with the BMS through Modbus RTU?
Modbus RTU is not supported with [product_name]. However, Modbus TCP is available on the most recent versions via the Ethernet port. Would integrating through Modbus TCP be an option for you?
Alternatively, you could use a Modbus RTU to Modbus TCP/IP converter or gateway.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to connect [company_name] [product_name] modules to a building management system using the Modbus RTU protocol. The initial question points out the need for Modbus RTU support, but replies clarify that only Modbus TCP is available on updated versions. Using a protocol converter is mentioned as a workaround. This highlights a gap between user expectations for industrial protocol support and current product capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect direct support for Modbus RTU on [company_name] [product_name] modules for integrating with building management systems. They seek straightforward compatibility with standard industry protocols.
